newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends little changed vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends little changed vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed almost unchanged at 8.3055 on Monday from 8.3056 last Friday against the U.S. dollar on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market, in dull trading, dealers said.

The yuan opened up at 8.3053 and consolidated in a narrow range of 8.3053 and 8.3055 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day high of 8.3052 early on and a low of 8.3060 in late trading. Trading was sluggish, with most done at about 8.3055, traders said.
Traders said the yuan was prevented from rising by heavy selling around the 8.3050 level.
"Pro-yuan sentiment was still strong today," one trader said. "But its rise was limited by selling, apparently from the People's Bank of China."
A second trader said the yuan was likely to be stable in the near future and might rise slightly to 8.3050. But traders believe on Tuesday it will move below 8.3050.
The yuan closed down slightly at 7.5980 from 7.5945 against 100 Japanese yen and down at an intra-day low of 1.0755 from 1.0746 against the Hong Kong dollar.
